pattern: file a thread in a folder
experience: Asked to put this thread in a folder, an agent moves it with t3_thread_organize move_to_folder instead of renaming the thread or saying it cannot.
rule: t3_thread_organize move_to_folder: into `folder`, created if new.

source.note: Agents had no way to file threads in folders or rename folders.

prompt: Put this thread in the Release folder.

pattern: take a thread out of its folder
experience: Asked to take this thread out of its folder, an agent moves it back to the project with remove_from_folder, and leaves the folder for the other threads.

source.note: A live Haiku run sent folder "null" when null meant back to the project, filing the thread in a folder named null.

prompt: Take this thread out of its folder, back to the project. Leave the folder itself alone.

experience: Asked to rename a folder, an agent renames it once with rename_folder instead of moving each thread.
rule: rename_folder: renames `folder` to `to` on every thread of the environment.

source.note: Agents had no way to file threads in folders or rename folders.

prompt: Rename my Inbox thread folder to Later.

experience: Asked to delete a folder but keep its threads, an agent removes the folder with delete_folder, and archives nothing.
rule: delete_folder: removes `folder`; its threads go back to their projects.

source.note: Agents had no way to file threads in folders or rename folders.

prompt: Delete the Old folder. Keep its threads, just put them back in their projects.

experience: Asked to pin this thread, an agent pins it and does not file it in a folder.

source.note: Agents had no way to file threads in folders or rename folders.

prompt: Pin this thread so I can find it later.
